name: Claude Mythos 5.1
description: Claude Mythos 5.1 is Anthropic's restricted-access Mythos release for approved Project Glasswing customers. Phaseo tracks the model but does not expose a public gateway route.

details.name: data_retention
details.value: 30 days; unavailable under zero data retention unless expressly authorized

details.name: tool_choice
details.value: Supports auto and none. Forced any or named-tool selection is not supported.

details.name: availability
details.value: Claude Mythos 5.1 is available only to approved Project Glasswing customers. Its direct Anthropic mapping is disabled and non-routable until Phaseo implements an explicit approved-customer gate.

page_notice.markdown: Claude Mythos 5.1 requires Project Glasswing approval and is not publicly routable through Phaseo.

sources.notes: Official migration guide for model ID, Project Glasswing access, limits, pricing, adaptive thinking, cache minimums, tool-choice restrictions, and retention requirements.
